title: PRQuant: Permutation Residual Quantization for Low-Overhead Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.22106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accuracy of Low-bit quantization of linear layers is often dominated by a small number of outliers. Although existing methods, such as smoothing, rotation, or residual-based approaches, may mitigate this problem, they often introduce new accuracy bottlenecks to weights. Besides, most of these techniques are implemented as online approaches, which can result in heavy execution overheads. To address the afore-mentioned issues, We propose PRQuant (Permutation Residual Quantization), a training-free and low-overhead framework that combines channel reorganization with static weight-side residual compensation. After AWQ-style scaling, PRQuant identifies the input channels that contribute most to weight quantization error, permutes them into contiguous tail blocks, and constructs their residual weight sub-tensors offline. translated_title: PRQuant：面向低开销推理的置换残差量化
translated_abstract: 线性层低比特量化的精度往往由少数离群值所主导。尽管现有方法（如平滑、旋转或基于残差的方法）可以缓解这一问题，但它们常常给权重引入新的精度瓶颈。此外，这些技术大多以在线方式实现，可能导致沉重的执行开销。为解决上述问题，我们提出了PRQuant（置换残差量化），这是一个无需训练、低开销的框架，它将通道重组织与静态的权重侧残差补偿相结合。在AWQ式缩放之后，PRQuant识别出对权重量化误差贡献最大的输入通道，将它们置换为连续的尾部块，并离线构建其残差权重子张量。在推理过程中，这种连续结构使激活侧能够无缝使用尾部块，而无需昂贵的……
tldr: PRQuant提出了一种无需训练的低开销量化框架，通过将对权重量化误差贡献最大的输入通道置换为连续尾部块并离线构建残差权重补偿，在不引入新精度瓶颈和运行时开销的情况下提升低比特量化精度。
en_tdlr: PRQuant is a training-free, low-overhead quantization framework that permutes the most error-contributing input channels into contiguous tail blocks with offline residual weight compensation, improving low-bit quantization accuracy without introducing new weight-side bottlenecks or heavy runtime overhead.
